pins.name: GPIO0
pins.label: GPIO0
pins.notes:
RP2350_PSRAM_CS / PIN_PSRAM_CS - dedicated chip-select line to the onboard 8MB QSPI PSRAM chip (v2-exclusive feature vs v1, per DatanoiseTV/PicoADK-Firmware-Template README). No static-const alias in this board's pins_arduino.h; entry added for documentation.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D2
pins.label: GPIO2 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_BUILTIN - onboard "user LED" per circuitpython.org/board/datanoise_picoadk_v2/ and the CNX Software v2 launch article ("Power and user LEDs" - no WS2812/NeoPixel mentioned for v2). Active-high polarity inferred (not independently confirmed for v2 - no pico-sdk board header exists for this third-party board): same vendor + same GPIO number as v1's PIN_LED0 (independently confirmed active-high), and 100% led_high precedent across every other RP2040/RP2350 LED_BUILTIN audited this session (rpipico, adafruit_macropad2040, akana_r1, rpipico2, v1 datanoisetv_picoadk).
